source_blend_scope: Latest family proof snapshot only; it currently contains the final field_saber pass, not Quarry Chopper. build.py plus the authored texture inputs are the editable Quarry Chopper source of truth (accepted pass-6 build).
space_notes: Accepted July 12 Pawn Forge export: +X toward the cutting edge, +Y from the grip toward the blade tip, +Z through blade thickness; origin is the grip midpoint.

mount_hand_r_local.derivation: Preserves the live Vibrosword grip-midpoint hand weld while rotating this export's +Y blade axis onto the established melee +Z blade axis; identical family convention to the promoted scrapline_machete.

stow_socket.derivation: Solved from the ACCEPTED Vibrosword back carry, same melee_early family frame as scrapline_machete. The previous placeholder was never consumed (SwordRig forced one global melee transform), leaving this chopper horizontal across the neck with the tip 0.44 m out past the pawn's left shoulder. rot_deg maps this family's +Y blade axis onto the accepted spine-local blade direction and its +Z thickness axis onto the accepted flat-normal, so the heavy blade lies flat on the back with the cutting edge lateral. pos seats this chopper's OWN measured midpoint (y=0.18475) on the accepted carry midpoint plus its half-thickness offset (0.0234 vs the Vibrosword's 0.0237); the short 0.58 m silhouette therefore rides high and centred on the back instead of dangling. Tip lands at spine-local y=-0.2214.

measured_runtime.grip_reference: grip midpoint at GLB origin; grip runs -0.086..0.086 along +Y
measured_runtime.socket_derivation: muzzle = measured blade tip (bbox +Y), stock = measured butt-cap end (bbox -Y), foregrip = upper grip just below the sleeve hand-stop flare (grip span +-0.086).

provenance: Byte-identical promotion of the accepted melee_early family export; Blender source and deterministic build script remain in Pawn Forge.
